title: A Canal Room in Venice: ~$300. The Same View in China: $30 | China Travel Expert
description:
A canal-view room in Venice runs about $300 a night. The same kind of room in a Chinese water town? Around $30.

Venice canal-view rooms start near €300 and climb from there, with the citywide hotel average around £301 a night. In China's canal towns — Xitang, Wuzhen and dozens more — a riverside guesthouse room runs roughly ¥200–300 (about $30), on the same stone-bridge canals with boats sliding past your window. Same postcard, roughly ten times cheaper.

🧭 Expert Tip: book a riverside room midweek — weekend nights in the famous water towns sell out first and cost the most; a Tuesday or Wednesday is quieter and cheaper.

威尼斯运河房一晚约300美元，中国水乡的运河房只要30美元左右——一样的石桥摇橹船，便宜十倍。
